integrity: All probability-limit statements are proved from explicit first-order rank profiles and rare-class generating functions; no experimental extrapolation is used.
scientific_limitations: No assertion for unequal block sizes, variable coloring bias, added random relations, or enriched counting logics.

scientific_scope: Ordinary first-order sentences in equality, an equivalence relation and one independent fair unary predicate, with both number and common size of classes tending to infinity.
title: Exact first-order convergence and Poisson critical windows for independently colored equal-block equivalence relations
